title: MAC vocabulary (mac_vocabulary.yaml)
description: The closed vocabularies and value domains. Governed for the same reason as everything else: a vocabulary that can grow a key nobody defined is not closed. Each block declares its kind and whether it is closed; a `vocabulary` carries `terms`, a `value_domain` carries `members`.

members.description: members of a value_domain or registry. A `canon` member declares what it serves, whether it needs sqlglot, and — the point of params_from — which of its parameters are READABLE from a concept declaration rather than attachable to a binding.

params_from.description: canon parameter -> the dotted concept path it derives from
